title: 4-72 POS — Ciberseguridad
description: Detección de fuerza bruta, IPs sospechosas, accesos denegados y eliminaciones críticas. Fuente: eventos_auditoria.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM eventos_auditoria WHERE datos_despueseventos_auditoria->>'accion' = 'LOGIN' AND datos_despueseventos_auditoria->>'resultado' = 'ERROR' AND created_ateventos_auditoria > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM eventos_auditoria WHERE datos_despueseventos_auditoria->>'accion' = 'DENIED' AND created_ateventos_auditoria > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM eventos_auditoria WHERE operacioneventos_auditoria = 'DELETE' AND created_ateventos_auditoria > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ip_origeneventos_auditoria) AS value FROM eventos_auditoria WHERE datos_despueseventos_auditoria->>'resultado' = 'ERROR' AND ip_origeneventos_auditoria IS NOT NULL AND created_ateventos_auditoria > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', created_ateventos_auditoria) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "logins fallidos" FROM eventos_auditoria WHERE datos_despueseventos_auditoria->>'accion' = 'LOGIN' AND datos_despueseventos_auditoria->>'resultado' = 'ERROR' AND created_ateventos_auditoria BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', created_ateventos_auditoria) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "accesos denegados" FROM eventos_auditoria WHERE datos_despueseventos_auditoria->>'accion' = 'DENIED' AND created_ateventos_auditoria BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT ip_origeneventos_auditoria::text AS ip, COUNT(*) AS "intentos fallidos", MIN(created_ateventos_auditoria) AS "primer intento", MAX(created_ateventos_auditoria) AS "último intento" FROM eventos_auditoria WHERE datos_despueseventos_auditoria->>'resultado' = 'ERROR' AND ip_origeneventos_auditoria IS NOT NULL AND created_ateventos_auditoria BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT u.nombreusuarios AS usuario, u.emailusuarios AS email, r.codigoroles AS rol, COUNT(*) AS denegados FROM eventos_auditoria ea LEFT JOIN usuarios u ON u.idusuarios = ea.usuarios_idusuarios LEFT JOIN roles r ON r.idroles = u.roles_idroles WHERE ea.datos_despueseventos_auditoria->>'accion' = 'DENIED' AND ea.created_ateventos_auditoria BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY u.nombreusuarios, u.emailusuarios, r.codigoroles ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT ea.created_ateventos_auditoria AS fecha, u.nombreusuarios AS usuario, r.codigoroles AS rol, ea.tablaeventos_auditoria AS recurso, ea.ip_origeneventos_auditoria::text AS ip, ea.mac_origeneventos_auditoria AS mac, ea.datos_despueseventos_auditoria->>'error' AS detalle FROM eventos_auditoria ea LEFT JOIN usuarios u ON u.idusuarios = ea.usuarios_idusuarios LEFT JOIN roles r ON r.idroles = u.roles_idroles WHERE ea.datos_despueseventos_auditoria->>'accion' = 'DENIED' AND ea.created_ateventos_auditoria BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY ea.created_ateventos_auditoria DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT ea.created_ateventos_auditoria AS fecha, u.nombreusuarios AS usuario, r.codigoroles AS rol, ea.tablaeventos_auditoria AS tabla, ea.registro_ideventos_auditoria AS registro_id, ea.ip_origeneventos_auditoria::text AS ip FROM eventos_auditoria ea LEFT JOIN usuarios u ON u.idusuarios = ea.usuarios_idusuarios LEFT JOIN roles r ON r.idroles = u.roles_idroles WHERE ea.operacioneventos_auditoria = 'DELETE' AND ea.created_ateventos_auditoria BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY ea.created_ateventos_auditoria DESC LIMIT 50
